recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core and do not re-add questionnaire-constraint to the core source. Any future changes to questionnaire-constraint, targetConstraint, or their guidance should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack and dependent IGs such as SDC.
issue_request: FHIR-15612 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification STU3 FHIR-core change request asking for a complex extension on Questionnaire and Questionnaire.item that could express StructureDefinition-invariant-style FHIRPath validation rules with identifier, severity, expression, human-readable message, and location components.
initial_application: The Jira comments cite SVN #14772. Git-svn commit b8c5990ac5ad735ba1e8e836fd8a4c6fd3534a3e for build@14772 explicitly listed issue 15612 and added the Questionnaire constraint extension rows to source/questionnaire/questionnaire-extensions-spreadsheet.xml, including the intended Questionnaire/Questionnaire.item contexts and validation-rule subcomponents.
additional_context: The current core checkout still builds Questionnaire, but it no longer has active questionnaire-constraint extension source; only the OID registry entry remains. Commit dd468d4f1799dd79819315b211588ef1cf4586e0 removed the generated R5 core extension source as part of moving standard extensions out of core. The FHIR Extension Pack now contains StructureDefinition-questionnaire-constraint, marks it retired/deprecated, and points users to targetConstraint. Published FHIR-extensions issue FHIR-45313 created targetConstraint and directed deprecating questionnaire-constraint; a 2026 Questionnaire Zulip thread also states that targetConstraint replaced questionnaire-constraint.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source edit was made because the current authoritative extension artifacts are in hl7.fhir.uv.extensions, outside this core checkout/build.
